input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Hearth & Horizon science fiction story, text only

doc_friction.issue: The 'Next up' Hearth & Horizon list was empty, so the run had to write its own proposal before drafting; the bible says to do this, which worked, but a one-line hint of under-used subject areas (overlap.mjs shows muon/carbonation unused) would save the search.
'search open PRs' suggests search_pull_requests, which the cloud MCP set does not expose; gh api search/issues returned nothing silently (no error, no items), so the duplicate check was weak.

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon (Hearth & Horizon shelf). Piece: the-old-man-under-the-nave (muography under a cracked church floor, Slovakia 2063), about 5,300 words, text only because audio folders total 577 MB (> 400 MB cap). Muon rates from the Gaisser surface spectrum plus dE/dX = a + bE, computed in a short script (scratchpad), every figure in the closing note; weekdays and Easter/Advent 2063 checked in code. Added the next proposal ('Lime that is still setting'). Local checks: node --test in the venture (17 pass), check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links, check_doc_counts clean; run_workflow_locally --for-changes run (see PR). The story's lede and summary were re-read once adversarially; fixes made: a 'Turks' anachronism, a significance figure (nearly seven -> over six), battery count, bone in fill removed.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a science writer researching muography and drafting a 5,300-word story with checked numbers

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
